meta.source: Extracted from reinnsolutions-site v2 index.html (the live reinnsolutions.xyz brand: --a, --a2, --bg, --bg2, --ink, --mut, --dim, --line, --card). State colours, the Paper theme and iris added for Mission Control and documents. Copper and charcoal sampled by eye from High-Resolution-Color-Logo.png (approximate; replace with the designer's values if they exist).

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Night is the site's --bg: warm near-black, never pure #000 except the live strip.

tokens.name: ground-2
tokens.usage: Alternate section band (site's section.alt / --bg2).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards and station tiles sitting on ground (site's --card).

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Inputs and result boxes (site's input / .result background).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Subheads and body copy under a headline (site's --mut). 12.6:1 / 7.4:1.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Captions, small print, helper text (site's --dim). 7.3:1 / 5.5:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections and around cards (site's --line). Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders (site's #ffffff40). 3:1 on card in Paper.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: THE brand colour (site's --a). Primary button fill, kicker text, italic emphasis in headlines, focus ring, the 'try it' border. On Paper use it as a fill only; for text use ember-ink.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: The logo's ground. Use behind the full logo lockup, on business cards, gig covers and the Owner's Sheet header. Not the site's ground (that's warm near-black).

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: The logo tree's mid-tone. Brand mark, wordmark rules and print. Fill or large type only on Paper; text on Paper uses copper-ink.

tokens.name: copper-light
tokens.usage: Highlight of the tree's gradient. Paired with copper for the mark's sheen; never a button.

tokens.name: copper-deep
tokens.usage: Shadow of the tree's gradient.

tokens.name: copper-ink
tokens.usage: The tagline colour ('Automate. Elevate. Dominate.') as text.

tokens.name: ember-soft
tokens.usage: Hover state of ember, big result numbers, nav hover (site's --a2).

tokens.name: ember-ink
tokens.usage: Ember as text or an icon. 8.4:1 Night, 5.4:1 Paper.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text on an ember fill. Buttons are dark-on-orange, never white-on-orange.

tokens.name: ember-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind the 'try it' tools and quick actions (site's .try gradient start).

tokens.name: hot
tokens.usage: Mission Control: act today (lead unclaimed past 2 hours). Added; not on the public site.

tokens.name: hot-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind a hot alert.

tokens.name: warm
tokens.usage: Mission Control: this week. Deliberately yellow, not orange, so it never reads as the brand.

tokens.name: warm-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind a warm alert.

tokens.name: calm
tokens.usage: Mission Control: all clear, claimed, live, paid.

tokens.name: calm-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind a calm alert.

tokens.name: iris
tokens.usage: The walled lane: recovery-program data and Elevated Lives. Seeing iris means handle with care. Never on a sales button.

tokens.name: iris-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind walled sections.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Site h1: clamp(46px,10vw,88px), leading .95. One per page. Emphasis word in italic 800, ember.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Station numbers and result figures (site's .st i, .result b). Italic Fraunces is the brand's numeral.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Text logo in the nav until the logo file is placed; the N' in ember.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A $300 site and your Google listing, live in 48 hours.
styles.usage: Hero lead in ink-muted; bold words go to ink.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You own everything, in your own accounts.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow in ember above every h2.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons. Verbs, first person where it fits ('Get my site').

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to input gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a CTA row; chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gap between station tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter and card padding (site's .wrap / .st).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Tool box padding (site's .try).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Below a subhead before content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding top and bottom.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Result boxes, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and station tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The 'try it' tool boxes.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges sitting on a box edge.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Focus ring on inputs and buttons (site's outline: 2px solid --a).
